title: L2-ARCTIC: a non-native English speech corpus
publication: Zhao et al. 2018 Proc. Interspeech DOI 10.21437/Interspeech.2018-1110
language_variety: L2 English; L1 Arabic, Mandarin, Hindi, Korean, Spanish, Vietnamese
manual_evidence: Official corpus documentation states ~150 utterances per speaker were manually annotated with corrected word and phone boundaries and tagged phone substitutions/deletions/additions; 3,599 utterances were human-examined in the documented corpus
available_primary_data: 24 speakers; 26,867 total utterances; 3,599 manually examined utterances; primary WAV recordings; manually corrected TextGrids available via license-gated download form
notes: Accept only the explicitly manual subset. Exclude corpus-wide forced-aligned word/phone boundaries unless they belong to the manual subset. Download requires name/email/affiliation plus license agreement, so no protected corpus bytes were copied in this run.
